content: Anutu noow-aso yiiy

+ o 3:1 Jon 1:12-13; 16:3*Ham akam bu le, Anutu nêêl nambe yite noow-aso yiiy ond taato nambe ahe yoo having yiiy bopaata lôôt, om yite noow-aso yiiy keen ondeey hil voon doosin yiiy, in dangga nambe sil doosin Anutu.

+ o 3:2 2Ko 3:18; Pil 3:21*Sate va-so, gêên yaatu Anutu-te unoopasiv, de vu taamusin yale mando naambe va? Vaa-ju me-neep langaah e, om yiiy doosin, lemu yalak ni nambe Kalisi naatok nom atombe yale naatu naambe yi, in yale aangge yi keen.
Tonde hil pin sen kand navu vaa-jo be danggin busin-anjuuto, ond sil oo davu samu sil alondpayo nivasa lôôt lohvu sen Kalisi yoo nando nivasa lôôt-ato.
Hil pin sen dawiing va nipayaa-to ond davu kalêêh Anutu-te tanasin, in va nipaya ond manyinjo vakasin kalêêsin.
+ o 3:5 2Ko 5:21; 1Pi 2:22-24; 1Jon 2:2*Ham alak ni nambe Kalisi laam in nambe kawiiy va nipaya na, in va nipaya ti me-neep hôôk Kalisi lopayo le.
+ o 3:6 Lom 6:1-2,14*Hil pin sen yoo dando hôôk Kalisi lopayôô-to ond me-dawiing va nipaya le, tonde hil pin sen dawiing va nipayaa-to ond sil-ame lalak Kalisi ni keen e, nganjo sil doosin.
+ o 3:7 1Jon 2:29*Unoopasiv-aso, ham-ame ambiing gaving hil-ate vakasin tatuhin e. Hil sen mondawiing va nivasaa-to ond sil hil anivalok nambe sen Kalisi omaaho nivalok-ato.

+ o 3:8 Jon 8:44*De hil sen mondawiing va nipayaa-to ond silate danggakook neep vu Saalang. In Saalang ond yoo monawiing va nipaya vu bôôy nyendoos lôôt-ambe nandôô-jo, lemu Anutu Noow ond laam in nambe kawiiy Saalang-ate kul na valok-ate.

+ o 3:9 1; Jon 5:18*Hil sen latu Anutu-te noondin-ato ond me-dawiing va nipaya le, in Anutu-te nôôn metumin nando hôôk sil, om sil-ame lalohvu nambe lambiing va nipaya le, in sil latu Anutu-te noondin lung laa-to.
Vaa-jo navu taato Anutu-te unoopasiv-aso de Saalang-ate unoopasiv-aso, in hil sen me-dawiing va nivalok-ato de ahend-ame naving halindin e, ond Anutu me-yite unoopasiv-aso sil e.
Ham ahem oo gaving ham
+ o 3:11 Jon 13:34*Vakasin sen ham oo hango vu bôôy nyendoos-ato ond nambe yahengg oo gaving yiiy.

+ o 3:12 Jen 4:8*De yame naambe Adam noow Kain e, in Kain ond Saalang-ate unoopasiv ti tombe yiis hali be yimb. De yiis halii-ju in dangga nambe vaati? Yik yiis in dangga nambe yoo monawiing va nipaya de hali monawiing va nivasa.
+ o 3:13 Mat 5:11-12; Jon 15:18-19*Halingg-aso, naambe hil voon lanji ham paya lôôt ond ham-ame kam yu-yuuh e.

+ o 3:14 Jon 5:24; 1Jon 2:11*Yahengg naving Omaaho Bop-ate hil om yalak ni nambe yiiy havuuh mop yimbin-ate lung la, de yiiy naaloh mopaatôôv metumin-ate. De omaaho sen ahe me-naving hil-ato le ond naahen naloh mopaatôôv yimbin-ate.

+ o 3:15 Mat 5:21-22; Taato 21:8*Omaaho sen yoo nayi hali paya lôôt-ato ond lohvu omaaho sen yiis omaaho ango be yimb-ato. Tonde ham oo alak ni nambe omaaho sen yiis omaaho ango be yimb-ato, ond me-naloh mop sen na mando metumin danggata-têêto le, malis.

+ o 3:16 Jon 13:1; Gal 1:4; 1Tes 2:8*Om nambêênja yalak ahe havingin danggakook ani nambe Kalisi yoo vu yi la doos-ambe yimb in dôôvu yiiy, om yik yiiy oo aambu yiiy na doos in dôôvu yiiy halingg-aso ond mem nivasa.
+ o 3:17 Diu 15:7*Le naambe omaaho ti-te va voon-ate nando, le yi nambe hali nativak in vati, lemu lopayo niwêêk-ambe me-hôôvu le, ond ahe me-having Anutu le, malis lôôt.
+ o 3:18 Jem 2:15-16*Unoopasiv-aso, ahe havingin-ame nanjip ak yavingg osin yiiy dalaangg malis amu le, nganjo yaambiing nôôn jak osin yahengg gaving keenaanôôn.
Yalonggpayo niwêêk-ambe yiiy baale Anutu me
Yahengg gaving naambêênjo ond mem yanjak ni naambe Anutu sen vakasin keen danggakook-ato noow-aso yiiy, tombe mem yalonggpayo gato javuh-ambe yiiy baale niwêêk hôôk Anutu me.

Le naambe yalonggpayo nayiis yiiy laah in nambe yaawiing va nipaya bôôy-ambe neep hôôk yalonggpayo om mak Anutu le bu dôôk nyevahaan vu yiiy, ond yalonggpayo gato javuh yi naah, in Anutu bopaata savok yalonggpayo la be lak va pin ani.
+ o 3:21 Hiblu 4:16*Sate va-so, naambe yalonggpayo me-nyiis yiiy in nambe Anutu me-le bu dôôk yate nipaya nyevahaan e, ond mem yiiy naale niwêêk hôôk Anutu me, de yame naayêênin e.
+ o 3:22 Mat 21:22*De va pin sen yiiy navu kataangg vu Anutuu-to ond navu vu yiiy, in yiiy navu samu yite tanasin-ambe yiiy naawiing va sen nayi nivasaa-to.
+ o 3:23 Jon 6:29; 13:34*Tonde yite tanasin ond nambêênjo nambe yaambiing gaving Yesu Kalisi naambe Anutu Noow yi, osin yahengg gaving yiiy nohvu tanasin sen Yesu yoo nêêl vu yiiy-ato.

+ o 3:24 Lom 8:9; 1Jon 4:13*Omaaho sen navu samu Anutu-te tanasin-ato ond yoo nando hôôk Anutu lopayo, tonde Anutu nando hôôk lopayo, de wiing yite Vavi Vaambuung laam vu yiiy om yalak ni nambe Anutu nando hôôk yalonggpayo.
